personal_info.name: Krishan Sharma
personal_info.availability: Currently open to full-time Python Developer / Machine Learning Engineer roles, internships, and freelance projects.
personal_info.short_intro: Results-driven Machine Learning Engineer with hands-on internship experience, specializing in AI-powered applications using Python, LangChain, RAG pipelines, and Generative AI frameworks.
personal_info.bio: Krishan Sharma is a Machine Learning Engineer based in Jaipur, India. He specializes in building AI-powered applications, NLP systems, RESTful APIs, and document intelligence solutions using LLMs and vector databases.

summary: Results-driven Machine Learning Engineer with hands-on internship experience, specializing in AI-powered applications using Python, LangChain, RAG pipelines, and Generative AI frameworks. Experienced in NLP systems, RESTful APIs, and document intelligence using LLMs and vector databases.

highlights: Designed and deployed NLP pipelines for text classification, entity recognition, and semantic similarity — achieving 90%+ model accuracy on internal benchmarks.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs using Flask and FastAPI to serve ML inference endpoints, reducing average response latency by 35% through async processing.
Developed and fine-tuned machine learning models using Scikit-learn for business use cases including predictive analytics and document categorization.
Implemented LLM-powered features using LangChain and Gemini AI, enabling intelligent document Q&A and automated text summarization workflows.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to deliver 3 production-ready AI features within sprint timelines.
Optimized PostgreSQL database schemas and integrated FAISS vector stores for efficient similarity search across large-scale text corpora.

projects.title: AI Chatbot with Gemini + PostgreSQL + FAISS
projects.overview: Architected a production-grade conversational AI chatbot leveraging Google Gemini LLM with LangChain orchestration for multi-turn dialogue management.
highlights: Multi-turn dialogue management via LangChain and Gemini AI.
Integrated FAISS vector store for sub-second semantic search over 10,000+ document embeddings.
FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend for persistent chat history, session management, and authentication.
Supported 50+ concurrent users with a 92% user satisfaction score in internal testing.

projects.title: RAG-Based Document Chatbot
projects.overview: Built an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline allowing users to upload PDFs and query documents in natural language with high precision.
highlights: PDF Q&A pipeline with document chunking, embedding generation, and FAISS vector indexing.
Reduced irrelevant context injection by 40% compared to naive prompting.
Deployed an interactive Streamlit UI for seamless document search.
Optimized prompt templates and retrieval chain logic to minimize hallucination.

projects.title: Binance Futures Trading Bot
projects.overview: Automated cryptocurrency futures trading bot executing real-time buy/sell orders based on custom algorithmic strategies on Binance.
highlights: Automated crypto trading via Binance API with real-time WebSocket market data streaming.
Strategy engine using RSI, MACD, and Bollinger Bands technical indicators.
Automated risk management with Stop-Loss and Take-Profit orders.
Backtesting framework using Pandas and NumPy on historical OHLCV data.

projects.title: Personal Finance Dashboard
projects.overview: Web app enabling users to upload a bank statement CSV and instantly see auto-categorized spending insights through interactive visualizations.
highlights: CSV bank statement upload and parsing via Pandas.
Keyword-based transaction auto-categorization.
Interactive Chart.js visualizations (pie, donut, bar, line graphs for monthly trends).
Flask + Pandas backend with sortable transactions table.
